name: Fruit Crush Frenzy
author: Addicting Games
description: Fruit Crush Frenzy is a free match 3 game. This is a game about matching at least three and then extrapolating that as far as you can to match four, five, hey maybe even six. SIX! Fruit Crush Frenzy lets you make connections by drawing lines between adjacent blocks of frut. Match at least three to make them disappear but don't stop there! In this game you don't just match orthogonally you can also match diagonally and spread your pattern all over the map. If you want to get strategic then you can aim to include one of the black bomb tokens that will explode an entire column and line for you. This is a game that rewards strategy as well as celebrating the tactical supremacy of pattern matching and slip-sliding your finger across the board to blow fruit up. Tell your friends, tell your family, tell an enemy, tell em all, we don't care who knows about this game. If you want to challenge people then go ahead and challenge anyone you can find.
